slide.text:
From the LMFS OP-020, the Official Source of TFR Information:
Normal Operations
  • TFRs (Text): FLTSCAPE
  • TFRs (Graphical)*: FLTSCAPE
  • *TFR Graphics and Survival Guides on FSLink are supplemental to the TFR text.

    • Backup Sources (During System Outages)
  • During system outages or specific software failures, information is provided to the flying public from designated certified internet sources.
  • TFRs (Text): AISR and NAIMES (PilotWeb)
  • TFRs (Graphical): FSLink and the FAA TFR website http://tfr.faa.gov

Though most TFRs have similar wording and boundaries never assume you or the pilot know all the information of the TFR.

Always read the details, such as:
  • All Center Point(s).
  • All Circumference(s).
  • All Effective Date(s)/Time(s).
  • All altitude(s)

    • No detail must be overlooked or assumed at any time.
    When safety is at risk no task is insurmountable.
    Again, Always read the details.
